name: cosmic-lens
description: Web app for viewing NASA photos of the Universe

paragraphs: Purpose: Gaze at photographs taken by the space telescopes including James Webb and Hubble. Automatically scale images to fit viewport. Be able to zoom and pan using user friendly controls, mouse, touch gestures. As an intermediate to senior developer, who has been professionally working exclusively on a closed source react app for years, this will be a portfolio piece, to show potential employers my up to date skills with react and web development.
Extras - information to learn about what the photographs show

App Config This will store app-wide settings. There will a dev and production version. In development, it will be important to generate a smaller number of lower quality images. :integer[] Scale This is a list of sizes use when generating image [ 7680, 3840, 2560, 1920, 1280, 1024, 768, 640, 320 ] for production [ 1280, 1024, 768, 320 ] for dev :integer quality (number used to configure generated image quality) maxPhotos (number to limit the total number of images processed)
